title: Checkbox (VisualElements)

scenarios.title: Checkbox applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Checkbox (BtnCheckbox) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Checkbox state codec, Wingdings symbol map and insert placement are pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The persistent AlternativeText codec writes 'oPE_Checkbox|{state}|{frame}|{size}|{color}' with invariant numbers (a fractional font size never carries a locale decimal comma; the -1 keep-color sentinel is written verbatim) and the lenient reader parses invariant first with a current-culture fallback so legacy current-culture tags keep their size, leaving caller defaults for missing or short tags and zero values for malformed fields; the state maps to the Wingdings tick, cross and space glyphs with the historical empty default for unknown states; a fresh checkbox is centered on the slide.

scenarios.title: Checkbox creates exactly one shape in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Checkbox command on an empty slide adds exactly one shape (measured shapeCountDelta=1), reports execution, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.
